draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.15, the 101st-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 14th of 37 at CB. He went 74th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (101st): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Tre Flowers. Testing standouts: 20-yard shuttle (90th percentile), three-cone (93rd percentile). Testing concerns: broad jump (10th percentile). College production: 3 passes defended in 2020, 24th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Green Bay Packers. 70 career games and 47 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 2 AV in 2025 against a career-best 4 in 2022. Strengths in 2025: missed tackle rate 0.0% (98th percentile), passer rating allowed 68.3 (91st percentile), completion % allowed 53.5% (86th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 cornerback who played: 35.0% season snap share against a median of 33.5%, above the norm.
